policy: Only byte-validated D1 ROI classes and type/subtype identities are named. Export routes describe currently implemented decoding stages; they do not imply semantic ownership or complete visual fidelity.

80800734.label: s_entity
80800734.notes: Entity root. Requires serialized child/EntityResource relationships before a composed visual export can be claimed.

80800861.label: EntityResource
80800861.notes: Generic EntityResource wrapper; inner class pair determines role.

80801AB5.label: s_entity_model
80801AB5.notes: Geometry can be exported in isolation. Correct visible-range, material, skin, owner, and placement selection remain separate evidence layers.

80801AD7.label: SMaterial_ROI_PS4
80801AD7.notes: PS4 D1 ROI material. Shader/texture arrays can be decoded; portable rendering requires shader-role translation.

808005A1.label: s_animation_clip
808005A1.notes: Clip payload can be decoded, but final skeletal animation requires a proven compatible runtime rig and skeleton/owner path.

80802C0E.label: animation_action_control
80802C0E.notes: D1 ROI action/state selector table. FileHash animation lists, StringHash states, packed selectors and empty sentinel are source-closed; semantic ownership remains a separate graph edge.

8080222A.label: animation_control_wrapper
8080222A.notes: Structured animation/control wrapper; preserved until owner/selector semantics are fully generalized.

808008B2.label: runtime_rig_payload
808008B2.notes: Runtime-rig role/component semantics are proven; some surrounding schema fields remain partial.

8080049A.label: skeleton_hierarchy_transforms
8080049A.notes: Validated skeleton hierarchy/default/inverse transform payload role.
